title: CONTINUE Statement
description: Learn how to use CONTINUE to skip the current loop iteration.

data.text: The CONTINUE statement stops the current iteration of a WHILE loop and starts the next iteration.

data.title: CONTINUE in a WHILE loop
data.code:
WHILE Boolean_expression
BEGIN
    -- code to be executed
    IF condition
        CONTINUE;
    -- code will be skipped if condition is met
END

data.title: CONTINUE skips number 3
CONTINUE Key Points
points: CONTINUE skips the current iteration and starts the next.
It can only be used inside a WHILE loop.
CONTINUE is often used with IF to skip specific iterations.
Unlike BREAK, CONTINUE does not exit the loop.
